name: Out of Sync: Crescendo
summary:
After the events of Out of Sync, Taisei continues to amaze his fans as a vocalist in the boy band 4LiGHT, while his now-boyfriend Shou quit the industry and has found peace working a menial job out of the limelight. On Valentine’s Day, Taisei wants to do something special for Shou and has a bright idea–strip poker! But will his competitive streak ruin what should be a wonderful evening…or will the other surprise he has in store get things back on track?

Crescendo is a short sequel game to Paper Star Studio’s BL visual novel Out of Sync!
